nodes.name: WhatsApp Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives incoming WhatsApp messages from Meta Cloud API

nodes.name: Is Verification?
nodes.notes: Meta sends a GET request to verify the webhook endpoint

nodes.name: Verify Response
nodes.notes: Returns hub.challenge to complete Meta webhook verification

nodes.name: Extract Message
nodes.notes: Parses WhatsApp webhook payload to extract student query

nodes.name: Acknowledge
nodes.notes: Immediately acknowledge to Meta (must respond within 5s)

nodes.name: AI Agent (Gemini)
nodes.notes: Same Gemini agent as web chat — uses system prompt with section mapping + holidays

nodes.name: Send WhatsApp Reply
nodes.notes: Sends response back to student via Meta WhatsApp Cloud API
